svg.title: The Analysis Map
svg.desc: From your research question, describe your data and check whether your outcome is normal. Then follow the arrow to Compare Groups or Examine Relationships, visualize, and choose the test that matches your question and your data.
svg.text: Is your outcome normal, or not normal?
